Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE/ SECURTY DEPOSIT: The successful bidder after placement of awar d shall furnish a Contract Performance Guarantee [CPG] towards faithful performance of the entire contrac t in accordance with the terms and conditions specified in the contract within 30 days of notification of Aw ard for an amount equivalent to 10% [Ten percent] of one month wage bill in the form of Bank Draft or Ban k Guarantee in favour of POWERGRID. CPG shall be kept valid f or period of Twenty-Seven (27) months fro m date of award. The Bank Guarantee must be from a Public Sec tor Indian Bank / reputed commercial Ba nk. Alternatively, it will be deducted from the agency’s monthly service charges in five equal installments @ 2% of monthly bill which will be refunded to the agency after three months of successful completion of t he contract. No interest shall be payable to the Security Agency ag against security deposits. Contract Period: The duration of the contract will be for 24 (Twenty-Four) months. If the service of the age ncy is found satisf actory during currency of the contract and getting sponsorship for new Security agency from DGR is taking time, POWERGRID may extend the contract for a further period of three months from t he date of its expiry. However, it will be sole prerogative of POWERGRID and agency shall not claim for ext ension as their right. Following documents to be submitted by security agencies alongwith bid submission: 1) PSARA 2) DGR Empanelment Certificate 3) Integrity Pact on 100/- non-judicial stamp paper - format attached in ATC 4) KMP Declaration - format attached in ATC . 3.
